---
title: "Write Repository Documentation"
doc-type: how-to
---

Use this guide when adding or changing Reference Source documentation.

## 1. Choose One Purpose

Assign exactly one `doc-type` in page frontmatter:

```yaml
doc-type: how-to
```

Choose `tutorial`, `how-to`, `reference`, or `explanation`. Project plans, ADRs, assessments, and routing maps still use one of these types even though the sidebar groups them under Project Record.

## 2. Respect The Authority Map

Before copying a fact, identify its owner:

- Domain language and product boundaries: `CONTEXT.md`.
- Current status and priorities: `PLAN.md`.
- Durable decisions: `docs/project-record/adr/`.
- CLI behavior: `src/repo_familiar/cli.py` and tested reference prose.
- Metadata schema: `src/repo_familiar/metadata.py` and its single human reference.
- Profile definitions: `src/repo_familiar/profiles.py` and `catalog`/`describe` output.
- Asset composition: `src/repo_familiar/asset_plan.py` and canonical templates.
- Ownership and focused tests: `docs/project-record/repository-map.md`.

Link or summarize when another surface owns the exact fact. Do not maintain parallel status, schema, profile, command, or asset inventories.

## 3. Keep The Page Type Clean

- Tutorials use known inputs, reliable steps, visible results, and verification.
- How-to guides assume a goal and include only the steps needed to achieve it.
- Reference pages favor exact tables and contracts over narrative progression.
- Explanation pages describe rationale, boundaries, tradeoffs, and rejected alternatives.

Split a page only when substantial sections serve different reader needs. Do not create a thin page merely to mirror the taxonomy.

## 4. Register The Page

Put product documentation in the directory matching its type: `tutorials/`, `how-to/`, `reference/`, or `explanation/`. Put plans, ADRs, assessments, requirements, and agent routing under `project-record/` while retaining their reader-facing `doc-type`.

Add every source page exactly once to the explicit `project.render` list and exactly once to the appropriate sidebar section in `docs/_quarto.yml`. The docs tests reject unclassified, misplaced, duplicate, and orphan pages.

## 5. Verify The Site

```bash
PYTHONPATH=src uv run pytest tests/test_docs.py
/usr/local/bin/quarto render docs
git diff --check
```

For navigation or presentation changes, inspect the rendered site at desktop and mobile widths, exercise keyboard navigation and search, and pair automated accessibility checks with manual review.
